results.title: HMS Seal (1897)
results.snippet: HMS "Seal" was a B-class torpedo boat destroyer of the British Royal Navy. She was completed by Laird, Son & Company, Birkenhead, in 1897.

results.title: USS Balch (DD-363)

results.title: USS Kilty (DD-137)

results.title: USS Macdonough (DD-351)
